verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation (via an API, CLI or scriptable runs) is a fair question for a SaaS FP&A platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows interactive, UI-driven features: ERP/HRIS integrations that pull data in and an Excel connector for push/pull. Neither is a documented way to drive the product programmatically, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.
